records.segregation: Complex segregation analysis favored recessive inheritance
quotes: We evaluated 55 consecutive cases of dilated cardiomyopathy in patients <10 y of age seen during a 5-y interval.
The 55 cases represented 20% of the offspring of 41 families of Arab descent. In 19 families (46%), parents were first cousins; there was no obvious consanguinity in 22 families (54%).
Age at presentation was <30 mo (95%) (range, 1 to 100 mo); males (38%) and females (62%) were affected. Patients died (25 patients, 46%), improved (15 patients, 27%), or recovered (15 patients, 27%).

records.label: Family with recessive DCM
quotes: We identified a novel TNNI3 mutation in a family with recessive disease.

records.label: Families with TNNI3 Lys36Gln or Asn185Lys
quotes: We report 2 novel TNNI3 missense mutations, Lys36Gln and Asn185Lys, each associated with severe and early onset familial DCM.
Of the 5 mutation carriers, cardiac transplantation was required in 3, at ages 6, 15, and 24 years.
These are the first reported autosomal dominant DCM-causing mutations in TNNI3
records.genotype_reason: single heterozygous variant; mode as stated for the family

notes.statement: Carballo et al. (2009) screened TNNI3 in 96 probands with dilated cardiomyopathy using heteroduplex analysis. They identified 2 novel missense mutations, Lys36Gln and Asn185Lys, each associated with severe, early-onset familial DCM. These were the first reported autosomal dominant DCM-causing mutations in TNNI3.
quotes: To test TNNI3 as a candidate gene, a panel of 96 probands with DCM was analyzed.
We report 2 novel TNNI3 missense mutations, Lys36Gln and Asn185Lys, each associated with severe and early onset familial DCM.

notes.statement: Carballo et al. (2009) found that troponin reconstituted with either mutant troponin I (Lys36Gln or Asn185Lys) gave lower maximum actin-tropomyosin-activated myosin ATPase rates and lower Ca(2+) sensitivity than wildtype. Mutant thin filaments also had reduced Ca(2+) affinity. The authors noted that these changes closely mirrored those of proven DCM mutations in other thin filament proteins.
quotes: troponin reconstituted with either mutant troponin I gave lower maximum ATPase rates and lower Ca(2+) sensitivity than wild type. Furthermore, mutant thin filaments had reduced Ca(2+) affinity compared with normal.
The functional alterations mirror closely a consistent phenotype found in proven DCM mutations in other thin filament proteins

notes.statement: Murphy et al. (2004) screened the TNNI3 gene in 235 patients with dilated cardiomyopathy using mutation analysis able to detect both dominant and recessive mutations, and identified a novel TNNI3 mutation in a family with recessive disease. They suggested that TNNI3 was the first recessive gene identified for this condition.
quotes: We used mutation analysis suitable for identification of both dominant and recessive mutations to investigate the sarcomeric gene for cardiac troponin I (TNNI3) in 235 patients with dilated cardiomyopathy.
TNNI3 is the first recessive gene identified for this condition

notes.statement: Murphy et al. (2004) found in functional studies that the TNNI3 mutation impaired troponin interactions, which could lead to diminished myocardial contractility.
quotes: Functional studies showed impairment of troponin interactions that could lead to diminished myocardial contractility.

notes.statement: KARIV et al. (1964) reported familial cardiomyopathy, with particular attention to electrocardiographic and vectorcardiographic findings.
quotes: FAMILIAL CARDIOMYOPATHY; WITH SPECIAL CONSIDERATION OF ELECTROCARDIOGRAPHIC AND VECTORCARDIOGRAPHIC FINDINGS.

notes.statement: Seliem et al. (2000) carried out complex segregation analysis under the mixed model of inheritance on the family data from 41 Arab families from the Eastern Province of Saudi Arabia with infantile dilated cardiomyopathy. A model of recessive inheritance fit the data best.
quotes: Complex segregation analysis of the family data using the mixed model of inheritance showed that a model of recessive inheritance best fits the data.

notes.statement: Seliem et al. (2000) found that the left ventricular shortening fraction at diagnosis (range, 5 to 28%) did not differ among the infants with dilated cardiomyopathy who died, improved, or recovered.
quotes: The left ventricular shortening fraction at diagnosis ranged from 5 to 28% and did not differ in those who died, improved, or recovered.

notes.statement: Seliem et al. (2000) suggested that recessively inherited dilated cardiomyopathy may have been reported rarely because it is hard to recognize in populations where consanguineous marriage is uncommon and families have few children.
quotes: Recessively inherited dilated cardiomyopathy has been infrequently reported, perhaps because it may be difficult to recognize in other patient groups in which consanguineous marriage is uncommon and the number of children per family is small.

notes.statement: Goldblatt et al. (1987) concluded from a review of the literature that the autosomal recessive form of dilated cardiomyopathy appeared to be more common than previously reported, although familial isolated dilated cardiomyopathy is usually reported as autosomal dominant with variable penetrance and expressivity.
quotes: Familial, isolated, dilated cardiomyopathy is usually reported as being inherited in an autosomal dominant mode with variable penetrance and expressivity.
Following review of the literature, it appears that the autosomal recessive form of dilated cardiomyopathy is more common than previously reported.
